question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"after"** means following in time; at a later time. (बाद में)

 
 
• **Example:** We went for dinner** after** the movie.
 
 
 
• **"Later"** refers to at a time in the future; after the time you are talking about. (बाद में)
 
 
• **Example:** She will call you **later.**
 
 
 
• ​Fill in the blank no. 4 requires a preposition that means an incident happened** afterwards.**
 
• we can infer that the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is **"after"**.
 
• Therefore, the correct statement is '**.........barely 15 years after__ Independence, '**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Later** (बाद में): Refers to at a time in the future; after the time you are talking about.

 
 
• **Example:** She will call you** later.**
 
 
 
• **Afterwards** (बाद में): At a later time; after an event that has already been mentioned.
 
 
• **Example:** We had tea, and **afterwards**, we went for a walk.
 
 
 
• **Behind** (पीछे): At the back of something; in or to a place that is further back.
 
 
• **Example:** She left her keys **behind.**
